description: Re-vendors the file-type SVGs from vscode-icons at a pinned commit: node packages/ui/src/file-icons/vendor.mjs

notes.text: Writes svg/*.svg (what ships) and svgs.ts (the same markup as strings, so the unit needs no bundler loader).
Pack file name → the recorded edits (see LICENSE). An ink edit swaps a fill that vanishes on one theme for the text colour.
